description: Open the historical stock price chart for NVIDIA (NVDA) and save it as an image. JStock is open with the watchlist loaded. Locate 'NVDA' in the watchlist, right-click it, and select 'History...' to open the chart window. Once the chart loads, right-click on the chart area, select 'Save as...', and save the image as 'NVDA_chart.png' in the '/home/ga/Documents/' folder.
